claims.text: UN COI (June 2026): at least 20,179 children killed and 44,143 injured 7 Oct 2023–7 Oct 2025; 30% of the dead were children vs ~24% in 2008–09 and 2014; 5,031 under 5 killed incl. 1,029 under 1; ~2% of Gaza's 1.2m children; Save the Children estimates 5,160 children under rubble.

COI found reasonable grounds that acts were part of a deliberate strategy to destroy the future of Palestinians in Gaza by targeting children; Gaza has 'the highest concentration of child amputees in the world'; COI records 40 Israeli children killed on 7 Oct and children taken hostage, attributing crimes to Hamas; Israel did not respond to 13 requests.
Israel's Geneva mission called the report a 'libelous sham' ignoring 'the brutal tactics of Hamas'; foreign ministry: commission 'fundamentally flawed', lacks 'any credible verification mechanism'.
UNICEF: at least 300 children killed in the 300 days after the Oct 2025 ceasefire; Beigbeder: 'A ceasefire that leaves an average of one child dead each and every day is failing children.'
PCBS (April 2025): 39,384 children lost one or both parents; about 17,000 lost both.
Ministry: 4,500 amputations by end-2024, about 800 of them children.
